name: Jindal Drilling & Industries Ltd
tagline: Offshore drilling services -- real rig-rate uncertainty flagged by a trusted user, plus deteriorating working capital
business_overview: Jindal Drilling -- offshore drilling and allied services (directional drilling, mud logging) for ONGC and other operators.
fundamentals_narrative: Weak ROCE (6.52%) for a capital-intensive offshore driller, and working capital days have deteriorated sharply (10.3 to 67.2 days) -- a real collections/cash-conversion concern.
technical_read: Not checked -- fundamentals/community signal were the deciding factor.
sentiment_summary: Read the most recent 50 of 166 posts (2025-04 to 2026-08). Thread centers on unresolved uncertainty over offshore rig day-rates: ONGC has pushed for a reduction from ~Rs 90,000/day toward Rs 35,000/day in some tenders, and management's own tone shifted from confident (>Rs 50,000/day) to non-committal across successive concalls. Latest update (Aug 2026, Q1 FY27): 'fairly good' quarter, one new ONGC contract secured (deploying Oct 2026), but 3 of 6 rigs still face de-hire/re-contracting risk this fiscal year.
community_signal: Swadesh9819 (trusted, elevated) flagged the ONGC rate-reduction risk directly (May 2025), and the uncertainty has not resolved -- management still hadn't committed to a rate number as of the most recent concall discussed in the thread. A non-trusted poster separately noted insider promoter buying (May 2026) as a positive signal.

trusted_signals.note: Flagged ONGC pushing for offshore rig day-rate cuts from ~Rs 90,000 to ~Rs 35,000, citing ONGC's own concall commentary and plans to build an in-house rig fleet -- a structural rate-pressure risk that remained unresolved through the most recent (Aug 2026) update in the thread.

bull_case: New ONGC contract secured for one rig (deploying Oct 2026), order book of Rs 1,310 Cr
Promoter stake increase noted by a community member (May 2026) as a positive signal
bear_case: A trusted user's structural rate-pressure concern (ONGC pushing day-rates down) remains unresolved more than a year later, with management itself avoiding committing to a rate number
Working capital days worsening from 10.3 to 67.2 is a real, current cash-conversion red flag, and weak ROCE (6.52%) reflects the capital intensity of the cyclical offshore-drilling business
verdict_headline: Genuine rig-rate uncertainty, flagged by a trusted user, remains unresolved a year later
verdict_reasoning: The trusted-user rate-pressure concern combined with weak ROCE and deteriorating working capital outweighs the one new-contract positive
No confirmed catalyst clears the bar for a 10x thesis in a capital-intensive, cyclical, rate-uncertain business
notes_short: Trusted rig-rate-pressure concern (May 2025) unresolved through Aug 2026, weak ROCE, WC days rising sharply
